verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API v2 and MCP server cover a broad set of core objects: feedback CRUD and search, documents with bulk operations and comments, features, initiatives, releases, OKRs, customers, teams, webhooks, analytics, and dynamic field-configuration endpoints. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full parity with the UI, and the probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of UI surfaces such as roadmap views, workspace settings and the built-in Spark/insight-detection AI features, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of coverage.
